description: This file defines the class FlexibleServletAccessor, which provides flexible access to Map values, supporting dot syntax for sub-map access and square bracket syntax for list element access, designed for handling request and session attributes in a servlet environment.

classes.name: FlexibleServletAccessor
classes.description: A generic class providing flexible get, put, and remove operations for servlet request and session attributes, supporting nested map and list access via syntax such as dot notation and square brackets.

classes.name: AttributeAccessor
classes.description: Inner static class that handles detailed attribute access, including support for list indexing, appending, and expander functionality.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the accessor with a name.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with a primary name or a default if the primary is empty.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes internal state based on the provided name, including expansion support and map accessor setup.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the accessor is initialized with an empty name.

methods.name: get(ServletRequest, Map<String, Object>)
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value from a ServletRequest, supporting nested maps and list indexing.

methods.name: get(HttpSession, Map<String, Object>)
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value from an HttpSession with support for nested maps and list indexing.
